# Impactly AI — Full Documentation

> AI-powered self-appraisal generator and weekly work log tracker.
> Privacy-first. RLS-isolated. No LLM training on your data.

## Overview
Impactly AI captures your weekly work achievements and generates promotion-ready self-evaluation narratives using the STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) framework. It aligns accomplishments with company values and OKRs automatically, so you never stare at a blank appraisal again.

## How It Works
1. Log your week in 5 minutes — record accomplishments, challenges, learnings, and goals in a simple weekly work log.
2. Connect your work to company goals — map entries to department OKRs and copy-paste your company's core values.
3. AI generates your self-appraisal — the engine drafts structured STAR-format self-evaluation responses referencing your concrete accomplishments.
4. AI Critique Assistant — an AI career coach reviews and improves your draft.
5. Export & submit — export STAR reviews, career reflections, and AI chat critiques.

## Key Features
- Weekly work log with structured achievements tracking
- STAR-format self-appraisal generation
- AI Critique Assistant (AI career coach chat)
- Company values alignment engine
- OKR mapping and goal tracking
- Customizable tone (Assertive & Data-Driven, Collaborative, Leadership-focused)
- Weekly email reminders (Monday 9 AM default)
- Privacy-first with Row-Level Security (RLS) database isolation

## Pricing
- Free tier: unlimited weekly work logs, consistency streaks, and full Q4 appraisal reports. No credit card required.
- Corporate / Enterprise: team and organization features including org settings and team goals. Contact sales for details.

Sign up via standard email or single-click Google/GitHub OAuth.

## Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How does the AI generate my self-appraisal?
A: It processes your private weekly log entries, correlates them with your company's core values and appraisal goals, and drafts structured STAR-format self-evaluation responses. By referencing your specific concrete accomplishments throughout the year, the generated review makes your impact clear and data-backed.

Q: Can I customize the generated tone and appraisal criteria?
A: Yes. You can set the writing tone (Assertive & Data-Driven, Collaborative, Leadership-focused), input your specific department OKRs, copy-paste company core values, or select a custom review period (weekly, quarterly, or yearly).

Q: Is there a free tier?
A: Yes — a robust free tier allows you to keep unlimited weekly work logs, track consistency streaks, and generate full Q4 appraisal reports. No credit card required. Sign up via standard email or with single-click Google/GitHub OAuth.

Q: Does it support email reminders?
A: Yes — automated, highly customizable email reminders (e.g., Monday morning at 9:00 AM) prompt you to spend 5 minutes documenting accomplishments.

Q: Is my data secure?
A: Yes. We implement database-level Row Level Security (RLS) to isolate user data completely, encrypt all data in transit and at rest, never sell your personal information, and never use your private logs to train large language models.

## Privacy Posture
"Your accomplishments belong to you. Period." Unlike many AI tools, Impactly AI never aggregates private logs, trains LLMs on user entries, or shares corporate documentation. Every check-in is encrypted and locked in the user's isolated database tenancy.
